label: D2 after a2->S2 following a rewarded trial, mid-late episode (trials ~50-72)
explanation: Fires only at D2, essentially only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 (common), and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1: 100% of mass). These conditions alone give recall 1.0 but precision 0.12. The other strong gate is position in the episode: no activity before trial ~40 or after ~80, peak at trials 50-70. That is likely a slow drift of the hidden state over the episode, not a task variable. Adding the episode window lifts F1 to ~0.59 (P 0.45, R 0.87, mass 0.90). Also enriched: the hidden good state is S2, value 7.7-8.1, and a strongly a2-favoring policy logit. Adding value>7.6 does not help much. Never fires at D1/GO, on S1, after unrewarded trials, or on rare transitions. All variables are observed at D2 (ep_trial is an episode-time correlate). Precision within the window stays incomplete.
